2026 Sample Grand Prix Qualifying (Synthetic Circuit, 5.00 km lap).
AAA (Sample Racing) lap 7 (fastest clean lap) on SOFT: 1:07.116; BBB (Example GP) lap 9 (fastest clean lap) on SOFT: 1:07.230.
AAA was 0.114 s faster over the lap.
Official sector gaps (who was faster): S1 AAA 0.017 s, S2 AAA 0.124 s, S3 BBB 0.027 s.
Where the time went (each turn counts from halfway after the previous turn to halfway to the next):
- T4 (2.60 km): AAA gained 0.174 s; apex speed AAA 85 km/h, BBB 81 km/h.
- T2 (1.30 km): AAA gained 0.097 s; AAA braked 5 m later; apex speed AAA 160 km/h, BBB 156 km/h.
- T5 (3.30 km): BBB gained 0.081 s; apex speed AAA 130 km/h, BBB 132 km/h.
Biggest lead during the lap: AAA by 0.191 s (around T4, 2.80 km); BBB by 0.080 s (around T2, 1.00 km).
Top speed: AAA 331 km/h, BBB 335 km/h.
Car data was frozen (not recorded) for BBB 3.44 to 3.50 km. Speeds and braking points that depend on it are left out, and the running gap there comes from lap timing.
The interactive chart shows both speed traces, the running gap, throttle and braking along the lap, with corner markers.
